verdict.rationale: Security and compliance posture is a fair question for a GPU cloud provider. The evidence pack has no SOC 2 attestation, data-handling policy, trust center, or datacenter tier or certification information. The only related items are adjacent: team-scoped API keys, user access management, and a passing mention of 'datacenter regions'. None of these lets a platform engineer verify the provider's compliance posture.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
